一道道错愕目光，汇聚向高台上的张云。
张云没理他，只是平静看向下方徐鸣，“你可愿拜我为师？”
徐鸣闻言转醒过来，毫无犹豫：“我愿意！”
“好！从今日起，你就是我张云之徒！！”
“宗主，我请求取消张云收徒资格！”
只见孟中面朝灵仙宗宗主，道：“虽为九长老，但张云从未收过徒弟，毫无眼力。眼下竟是想把这种废人收入宗内，浪费我宗资源。我强烈建议取消他收徒资格！”
张云冷斥道：“在你眼中是废人，那就是废人了？别自以为是了！在我看来，徐鸣非但不是废人，反而还是个天才！”
此话一出，不仅孟中，在场之人都是一愣。
仿佛听到了天大的笑话，孟中忍不住大笑出声，“张云，我看你是修炼走火入魔把自己也修炼傻了吧？这么一个明显的残灵根废人，你说天才？”
说着，孟中忽然想到什么，笑道：“这样吧，你既觉得他是天才，不如我们比比？”
“比弟子，顺带也比比我们身为师傅该有的指点能力！”
孟中淡淡开口，眼神在会场内扫了一圈，最后锁定在演武区的两块一米青石上：“就用这两块演武石来比。你教导你这位‘天才’弟子，而我也不欺负你，就教教我这位下品灵根的新弟子聂志。”
“我们各自对自己弟子进行一番指点。经过我们指点后，谁的弟子能给演武石带去更大的破坏，就算谁赢！你若赢了，我就承认你这位弟子是天才，同时承认你收徒的资格。但你若输了，就取消收徒资格。可敢一比？”
孟中冷笑一声，“若是不敢，那就承认你没眼力，滚回第九峰去！”
张云淡淡开口，“我只是觉得不公平！”
张云道：“按你所说，我输了，彻底失去收徒资格。而我若赢了，你实际上什么代价都不需要付出。十长老，你不觉得你是在空手套白狼吗？”
张云想了想，竖起一根手指：“一万灵石。我赢了，你赔我一万灵石作为污蔑我的补偿！”
灵石，是仙道大陆修士之间货币，同时也是最重要的修炼资源。
哪怕身为灵仙宗长老，一年能得到的供奉也只有两千灵石而已，这已经相当于一位长老五年的供奉。

A series of stunned eyes converged on Zhang Yun on the high platform.
Zhang Yun ignored him and just looked down at Xu Ming calmly, "Are you willing to worship me as your teacher?"
Xu Ming woke up after hearing this and said without hesitation, "I do!"
"Okay! From today on, you are my disciple, Zhang Yun!!"
"Sect Master, I request that Zhang Yun's qualification as a disciple be revoked!"
I saw Meng Zhong facing the leader of Lingxian Sect and said: "Although he is the ninth elder, Zhang Yun has never accepted a disciple and has no discernment. Now he actually wants to bring such a useless person into the sect and waste our sect's resources. I strongly recommend that he be disqualified from accepting disciples!"
Zhang Yun scolded coldly: "In your eyes, is a useless person, then he is a useless person? Don't be so self-righteous! In my opinion, Xu Ming is not only not a useless person, but also a genius!"
As soon as these words came out, not only Meng Zhong, but also everyone present was stunned.
As if he had heard a big joke, Meng Zhong couldn't help laughing out loud, "Zhang Yun, I think you have gone too far in your practice and made yourself stupid because of your practice, right? For such an obvious cripple with a residual spirit, how do you call him a genius?"
As he said this, Meng Zhong suddenly thought of something and said with a smile: "Well, since you think he is a genius, why don't we compare?"
"Comparing with disciples, and by the way, also comparing our ability as masters to give guidance!"
Meng Zhong spoke calmly, his eyes swept around the venue, and finally locked on the two one-meter blue stones in the martial arts area: "Let's use these two martial arts stones for comparison. You teach your 'genius' disciple, and I won't bully you, so teach me this new disciple Nie Zhi, who has a low-grade spiritual root."
"We each give guidance to our own disciples. After our guidance, whoever's disciple can bring greater damage to the martial arts stone will win! If you win, I will admit that your disciple is a genius, and at the same time recognize your qualification to accept a disciple. But if you lose, your qualification to accept a disciple will be revoked. Do you dare to compete?"
Meng Zhong sneered, "If you don't dare, then admit that you have no eyesight and go back to the Ninth Peak!"
Zhang Yun said calmly, "I just think it's unfair!"
Zhang Yundao: "According to what you said, if I lose, I will completely lose my qualifications to be a disciple. But if I win, you actually don't have to pay any price. Tenth Elder, don't you think you are using your hands to gain nothing?"
Zhang Yun thought for a while and raised a finger: "Ten thousand spirit stones. I win, you pay me ten thousand spirit stones as compensation for slandering me!"
Spirit stones are the currency among monks in the Immortal Continent, and they are also the most important cultivation resource.
Even as an elder of the Lingxian Sect, the offerings he can receive in a year are only two thousand spirit stones, which is equivalent to five years of offerings from an elder.
